data_description.t_venku: The outdoor temperature. It decides how long to ventilate and whether cooling makes sense at all.
data_description.rh_venku: The outdoor humidity. The dew point is computed from it, so no damp is pulled inside.
data_description.zareni: A solar radiation sensor in W/m2. It reveals cloud cover, so nothing is shaded needlessly.
data_description.vitr: Average wind speed. Above the threshold windows close.
data_description.naraz_vetru: Wind gusts. They take precedence over the average, because they damage the drive sooner.
data_description.dest: Rain intensity. It shortens ventilation and closes the windows in heavy rain.
data_description.doma: When this is off, the windows close and the rooms count as empty.
data_description.cil_min: The target never drops below this, even in hard frost.
data_description.cil_max: The target never rises above this, even in a heatwave.
data_description.noc_od: When quiet hours begin. Windows then open less often and only when the air is really stale.
data_description.noc_do:
When the night rules end. Until then a higher CO2 threshold applies and nothing opens just because the weather is pleasant.

The room's sleep switch works regardless of the clock: while it is on, only CO2 decides.
data_description.vitr_prah: The steady wind speed above which windows close and must not open. A weather station reports the current speed plus gusts; no average is computed.
data_description.t_prumer: Optional. If you have your own statistics sensor for the weekly average, enter it and it will be used. Without it the integration computes the average itself. The “Outdoor temperature, weekly average” entity then shows what is actually in use.
data_description.t_sezona: Optional. Your own three-day average sensor for the heating season. Without it the integration computes it itself.
data_description.sezona_prah:
Below this average outdoor temperature the heating season begins. The Czech regulation speaks of 13 °C on two consecutive days, and in practice heating tends to start only below that — fifteen is too early in many buildings.

It is computed from the weekly average, not the current temperature, so one cold morning does not start the season.
data_description.sezona_hystereze: How many degrees the outdoor temperature has to climb above the threshold for the season to end. The season starts below the threshold and ends above the threshold plus this number. Zero means no hysteresis, but then it may flip at the edge.
data_description.naraz_prah: Gusts damage the drive sooner than steady wind, hence a threshold of their own. It is enough for one of the two values to cross it.
data_description.vitr_klid: The block is released only once both values drop below this. It must be lower than both thresholds, otherwise it flips at the edge.
data_description.zpravy_kam: A notify entity, for instance Telegram or the mobile app. For Telegram the integration creates one entity per chat, so you pick the recipient here rather than typing a number.
data_description.souhrn_cas: When to send the daily summary: how many times the window moved, how long it stayed open, the highest CO2. That is how you tell whether the thresholds are right.
data_description.zpravy_druhy: Tick what interests you. In the first days ordinary openings are useful too; after that protection and the summary usually suffice.
data_description.narazove_vetrani: When it is cold outside and one zone needs air, every window opens at once and briefly. A draught exchanges the air faster than long ventilation through a single window and the walls have no time to cool down. Where something is in the way — wind, rain, the limits — that window simply stays shut.
data_description.narazove_odstup:
How far the outdoor temperature has to differ from the target — either way — before burst ventilation takes over.

In burst mode nothing opens for pleasant weather, because there is none outside. It ventilates only for a reason, that is for CO2, dust or temperature, and closes the moment the reason is gone — it waits neither for the whole cycle nor for the “Shortest time to hold a position”.

The mode switches with half a degree of hysteresis, so it does not hop about when the temperature hovers at the threshold.
data_description.pm25_venku: Dust outside. It tells us whether ventilating for dust makes any sense — when it is worse outside, opening will not improve anything and it would just ventilate in circles. Without this sensor only the smog flag is used.
data_description.pm10_venku: The same for larger particles. Optional.
data_description.smog_venku: A switch or sensor saying the outdoor air is not worth breathing. When it is on, nothing opens for dust — ventilating would only make it worse.
data_description.sezona_rezim: By average means the season is read from the three-day outdoor temperature. Always means heat all year, never means not at all — useful when you decide the season elsewhere.
data_description.topeni_obnova_min: A Zigbee valve occasionally loses a command and the integration never learns about it. After this time the last value is sent again even though nothing changed. Zero means send only on a change.
data_description.zima_prah: The adaptive standard is written for summer comfort and in winter it simply rests on the lower bound. In frost, though, walls and windows get cold, the radiant temperature drops and the same air feels cooler. Zero means off.
data_description.pryc_utlum_topeni: How much to take off when the home is empty. Zero means no setback. A deeper setback does not pay off in masonry: the structure cools for hours and takes just as long to warm up, so you burn more than you save.
data_description.pryc_utlum_po_hodinach: How long the room must stay empty before the setback applies. A short absence does not pay for itself.
data_description.noc_utlum_predstih: How long before night starts the drop begins. A gradual ramp beats a step, because both valves and masonry react slowly. Zero means in one step.
data_description.zima_o_kolik: How many degrees to add when it is really cold outside. Nothing more is added beyond that — deeper frost changes nothing.
data_description.zima_najezd: How many degrees below the threshold reach the full value. With a threshold of 7 and a ramp of 2.5 the full boost applies from 4.5 °C.
data_description.zmena_podminek:
After a futile attempt it waits for the outdoor temperature to move by this much — and only in the direction that would help: colder for cooling, warmer for heating. A move the other way improves nothing.

It is measured from the temperature at the last futile attempt, not the first; every further attempt therefore starts a fresh comparison.

Zero disables only the wait for conditions — the “Or at the latest in” ceiling still applies. Emergency ventilation and a manual request always get past it.

The wait also ends on its own as soon as the reason for ventilating disappears: the temperature comes back inside the band, or the air clears without the window. There is then nothing left to postpone, not even the ceiling. Ventilation for comfort is the exception — there was no reason to begin with, so the wait stays; otherwise the window would keep opening and closing on a pleasant day.
data_description.nejdriv_znovu_min: The waiting ceiling: even if nothing changes outside, it tries again after this time. If things change outside sooner, it tries sooner — this time delays nothing.

tester.title: Blind tester
tester.description:
Try the sequence on a real blind. You will see the position before and after, and if it fits, you save it under a name.

A number is a position in percent, “3s” is a wait, “=5” waits until the drive reports 5 %, “stop” halts it mid-travel, “tilt 40” angles the slats. Separate steps with commas and write decimals with a dot.

Example: 0, =0, 5

data.timeout_polohy_s: Wait for the position at most

data_description.timeout_polohy_s: Applies to steps like “=5”. If the drive does not report its position, the wait times out and you get an error.

stavy.title: Blind positions
stavy.description: Pick the blind whose named positions you want to edit.

stavy_text.title: Blind positions
stavy_text.description:
One position per line in the form “name = sequence”.

A number is a position in percent, “3s” is a wait, “=5” waits for the position to be confirmed, “stop” halts it mid-travel, “tilt 40” angles the slats. Write decimals with a dot.

Example:
shaded = 0, 2s, 5
unshaded = 4, 3s, 2
slit = 0, 5s, 2.9, 1.25s, stop

Saving replaces every position of this blind. An empty field deletes them.

ulozit.title: Save the position
ulozit.description: The sequence {sekvence} will be saved under this name. The same name overwrites the old position.

karta.title: Dashboard card
karta.description: A single card is quick to paste; a full page rearranges better and fills the width of the screen.

karta_jedna.title: Single card
karta_jedna.description:
A card for {pocet} rooms and {oblasti} zones, built from entities that really exist.

Select the text and copy it. Then on the dashboard: pencil → Add card → Manual at the very bottom → clear the content → paste.

karta_stranka.title: Full page
karta_stranka.description:
A page for {pocet} rooms and {oblasti} zones, split into sections you can grab and move.

Select the text and copy it. Then on the dashboard: pencil → three dots → Raw configuration editor → paste the block into the views list as another item.

zaklad.title: Room and devices
zaklad.description: What the room has: sensors and devices. Without this the integration does not know what to control.

data.pm_platny: When the dust reading is valid
data.zdroj_okenniho: Window sensor for heating based on

data_description.nazev: What the room is called. You use this name to assign it to a zone.
data_description.teploty: You can pick several sensors. In the cold the lowest decides because of condensation, in the heat the highest, so no hot air is let into an overheated room.
data_description.co2: You can pick several sensors. The highest one decides, that is the most stale air.
data_description.pm25: Dust particles. A jump upwards triggers burst ventilation, typically while frying.
data_description.pm10: Coarser dust. Leave empty if the sensor does not measure it.
data_description.pm_platny: A dust sensor needs moving air. If it has a fan, pick its switch — with the fan still, the readings are not trusted. If you have no fan, leave it empty.
data_description.climate: The room's valves — both a virtual one from Better Thermostat and a real one. The integration sends them the target temperature and mode while the Control heating switch is on.
data_description.cisticka: An air purifier. It handles dust, not CO2. In winter and at night it beats opening a window.
data_description.rh_vnitrni: Humidity sensor in the room. Without it the extraction is not controlled.
data_description.azimut: Which way the windows face. 0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west. That is how we know when the sun reaches the room.
data_description.zaluzie: This room's blinds. You can pick several — in the next step you assign which saved position plays which role for each of them.
data_description.okna: This room's windows. You can pick several; they will be controlled together.
data_description.kontakt_okna: A physical opening sensor. It also catches a window opened by hand that the drive knows nothing about — the integration then does not open it a second time and the heating knows it is open.
data_description.zdroj_okenniho: How the heating learns the window is open. If the window has no contact and you do not want a manual opening to switch the heating off, pick the automation only.
data_description.vynuceno_okno: Switches that force the window open. They override air and temperature, but not wind and rain.
data_description.t_venku_mistni: When the window opens onto a balcony or a conservatory, the air behind it differs from the one at the façade. Enter a sensor from there and it overrides the global outdoor temperature.
data_description.rh_venku_mistni: Humidity from the same spot, for the dew point.
data_description.zvlhcovac: A humidifier, a switch or a helper. In winter the air dries out and drops below thirty percent, which already dries your airways.
data_description.dvere: The door contact between rooms of a zone. A closed door means the air is not exchanged and window noise does not carry — sleep in one room then does not stop the other from ventilating.
data_description.vetrat: Switches that say you want the room aired out even though the sensors report nothing. Unlike a forced opening, the usual rules hold — wind, rain and the temperature limits still apply, the room is merely treated as stale until you switch it off.
data_description.poradi: Where the room belongs on the generated card. A lower number goes higher. With equal numbers they follow the order in which the rooms were created.
data_description.zaskleni:
The glazing tells us how cold the glass is, and from that the highest humidity at which it still does not fog up. In frost the glass sits around five degrees, and with twenty-two in the room and sixty percent the dew point is about fourteen — so the window fogs up even though the humidity itself looks reasonable.

The upper humidity limit therefore lowers itself in frost. At twenty-two degrees and minus five outside it comes out at 67 % for double glazing and 53 % for older glazing.

pritomnost.title: When it counts as occupied
pritomnost.description: Occupied means take care of it. Quiet means stay silent.

data_description.zdroj_obsazenosti: An occupied room is kept at the target. An empty one is left be.
data_description.zdroj_klidu: During quiet hours windows move as little as possible.
data_description.spanek: A switch you use to say that someone is sleeping in the room.
data_description.pritomnost: A motion sensor. On its own it is not enough, because it does not see a person sitting still.
data_description.dobeh_min: How long after the last motion the room still counts as occupied.
data_description.max_stari_h: If a sensor stays silent for this long, its battery has most likely died and it stops being trusted.
data_description.stineni_pryc: What the blinds should do when nobody is home.

indicie.title: Supporting evidence
indicie.description: A TV, lights or power draw hint that somebody is there even when they do not move.

data_description.indicie_stav: Entities where being on means somebody is there. A TV, lights, a media player.
data_description.indicie_vykon: Power draw sensors. Above the threshold the room counts as occupied.
data_description.prah_vykonu: Above this draw it is more than standby. For a TV usually 15 to 30 W.
data_description.indicie_dobeh_min: How long it still counts after switching off. Someone who just turned the light off has not left yet.

data_description.rh_max: Above this humidity the humidifier switches off. Between the lower and upper limit nothing happens, so it does not keep toggling.

data_description.klid_stineni_min: The minimum gap between blind movements, so the slats do not sway with every passing cloud.
data_description.zaluzie: This room's blinds. You can pick several — in the next step you assign which saved position plays which role for each of them.
data_description.okna: This room's windows. You can pick several; they will be controlled together.
data_description.projezd_okna_s: How long the drive takes from one end position to the other. While it travels we trust our own command, not the entity state.
data_description.kontakt_okna: A physical opening sensor. It also catches a window opened by hand that the drive knows nothing about — the integration then does not open it a second time and the heating knows it is open.
data_description.zdroj_okenniho: How the heating learns the window is open. If the window has no contact and you do not want a manual opening to switch the heating off, pick the automation only.
data_description.vynuceno_okno: Switches that force the window open. They override air and temperature, but not wind and rain.
data_description.co2_otevrit: Above this value ventilation starts. The worst value in the whole zone is used. It can also be changed with the slider on the dashboard — it is the same value. A change here moves the slider, because we treat it as an explicit instruction.
data_description.co2_zavrit: Below this value the air is cleared. Between the thresholds nothing happens on purpose. It can also be changed with the slider on the dashboard — it is the same value. A change here moves the slider, because we treat it as an explicit instruction.
data_description.co2_noc:
At night the opening threshold is higher, so nothing opens over a trifle. While sleeping not even this one opens the window — there only the emergency threshold decides.

It closes once the air is cleared at “Close below CO2”, just like during the day; one closing value instead of two.
data_description.co2_noc_krize: Above this it opens even at night and during sleep, because stale air is by then worse than window noise. While sleeping it is the only reason the window opens at all.
data_description.dest_prah: Above this rain intensity the window closes. Zero means rain always matters. A high value means rain does not bother this window — for instance when it sits under an eave.
data_description.i_kdyz_nikdo_doma: By default windows close when the home is empty. Turn this on if this particular window is safe to leave open.
data_description.t_venku_mistni: When the window opens onto a balcony or a conservatory, the air behind it differs from the one at the façade. Enter a sensor from there and it overrides the global outdoor temperature.
data_description.rh_venku_mistni: Humidity from the same spot, for the dew point.
data_description.min_drzeni_min:
The shortest time the window stays in the position it reached. It keeps it from flying back and forth.

After this time it is also checked that the ventilation works at all: if neither CO2 nor the temperature moved for the better, the window closes and the pause doubles with every further futile attempt. Emergency ventilation and a manual request are not held by this.
data_description.odvzdusneni_h: After the season starts, a high temperature is held for this long so the valve stays open and the pipework bleeds itself. Zero means do not bleed.
data_description.odvzdusneni_t: A temperature that guarantees a fully open valve. It is not meant to heat, only to open.
data_description.stineni_predstih: Shading should come before the room overheats. The lead time says how far below the target shading already starts. One degree means: target 25, shade from 24.
data_description.zvlhcovac: A humidifier, a switch or a helper. In winter the air dries out and drops below thirty percent, which already dries your airways.
data_description.rh_min: Below this humidity the humidifier switches on. In a winter flat it commonly drops under thirty percent, which already dries out your airways.
data_description.dvere: The door contact between rooms of a zone. A closed door means the air is not exchanged and window noise does not carry — sleep in one room then does not stop the other from ventilating.
data_description.topit_pri_oknu: We give the valve a window sensor, so it can handle an open window itself — that is the default, Leave it to the valve. Use setback or off only with a valve that has no window sensor, otherwise you are telling it the same thing twice.
data_description.sezonu_ridi_hlavice:
Better Thermostat decides for itself when to heat, based on the weather. With this ticked, the integration sends it only the target temperature and respects its decision to switch on — when it judges that it should not heat, the integration will not start it.

Untick it if you want the integration to decide the heating season: in season it sends heat, outside it off, and the valve is left with valve calibration, which it does best.
data_description.znacka_okno: The temperature the valve is given when a window is open and it cannot read a window sensor itself. Better Thermostat sends 5.0, so the default here is 5.5 — the value then tells you whose command it was.
data_description.znacka_mimo_sezonu: The temperature the valve is given outside the heating season. It is used only when the valve does not decide the season itself. An odd number instead of a round one reveals that the command came from the integration.
data_description.vetrat: Switches that say you want the room aired out even though the sensors report nothing. Unlike a forced opening, the usual rules hold — wind, rain and the temperature limits still apply, the room is merely treated as stale until you switch it off.
data_description.rucni_klid_min: When you open or close the window by hand, any ventilation in progress is dropped and for this long nothing interferes with the window. Wind and rain will still close it. Zero means the automation carries on at once.
data_description.ochota_vetrat: In some places an open window is unpleasant even when the temperature is fine — a kitchen window draughts on whoever stands at the counter. Elsewhere it can stay open all day and nobody minds. That is how we decide which room ventilates for which. Sleep overrides it: where someone sleeps, nothing ventilates anyway.
data_description.poradi: Where the room belongs on the generated card. A lower number goes higher. With equal numbers they follow the order in which the rooms were created.
data_description.cisticka_od_pm: The dust level at which the purifier should run. It switches off once the value drops to three fifths of the threshold, so it does not toggle at the edge. PM10 is derived from the same number and is usually about one and a half times higher.
data_description.zvlhcovac_kdy:
When the humidifier may run. In a bedroom “only while sleeping” makes sense, in a living room rather “only when someone is in the room” — humidifying an empty room is a waste.

With a window open it never humidifies; that would mean humidifying the street.
data_description.zaskleni:
The glazing tells us how cold the glass is, and from that the highest humidity at which it still does not fog up. In frost the glass sits around five degrees, and with twenty-two in the room and sixty percent the dew point is about fourteen — so the window fogs up even though the humidity itself looks reasonable.

The upper humidity limit therefore lowers itself in frost. At twenty-two degrees and minus five outside it comes out at 67 % for double glazing and 53 % for older glazing.
data_description.chlazeni_min_venku:
Below this outdoor temperature, cooling by ventilation will not start.

The lower edge of the hysteresis band would stop the room by itself, but closing is not instant — the “Shortest time to hold a position” applies — and cooling follows the warmest sensor, so it gets markedly colder by the window in the meantime. The colder the air, the bigger that difference.
data_description.pm_spatne_od: From this level the air counts as dusty and gets ventilated. PM10 is derived from the same number and is usually about one and a half times higher.
data_description.pm_cisto_pod: Below this level the air counts as clean. The gap between the two thresholds keeps it from toggling at the edge.
data_description.hyst_den_otevrit: How far the temperature has to drift from the target before it opens the window — above the target it cools with outdoor air, below it heats with it. It applies symmetrically on both sides.
data_description.hyst_den_zavrit:
How far past the target it runs before closing: below the target when cooling, above it when heating. Closing exactly at the target means the temperature starts coming back at once.

It is also the tolerance for temperature-driven ventilation. Ventilation for CO2 or dust waits until the air is cleared and is held only by the limits.
data_description.hyst_noc_otevrit: The same for night hours and sleep. At night a wider band is usually set, so the window stays put.
data_description.hyst_noc_zavrit: The same for night hours and sleep.
data_description.mez_dolni:
An absolute lower limit: below it the window closes, whatever it is open for. Only a manual request to air out gets past it.

It replaced the former night limit and the sleep limit, which did the same job in three places.
data_description.mez_horni: An absolute upper limit against overheating: above it the window closes, whatever it is open for.
data_description.pro_pohodu:
It may open even when there is no reason to — the air is fine, the temperature is inside the band and the weather is pleasant.

Turn it off and the window will open only for a reason: CO2, dust, cooling or heating.
data_description.zvlhcovac_ve_spanku: The humidifier may run with the sleep switch on as well. Turn this off if you can hear it in the bedroom.
data_description.rezerva_venku:
How far past the band's run-down the outdoor air has to be before ventilation starts at all — that much below the lower edge when cooling, that much above the upper one when heating.

Without that margin the cycle crawls up to the edge and never crosses it, so the ventilation never finishes its run and the room just cools down.
data_description.prach_dosah:
An ultrasonic humidifier sprays minerals from the water and sensors see them as dust. That would trigger ventilating and purifying even though it is the humidifier's own aerosol — and that cannot be ventilated away.

The aerosol does not respect the zone, because a zone is defined by shared air for CO2. The reach is therefore set separately; by default it covers the whole home.
data_description.prach_mistnosti: Applies only with “In selected rooms”. For a large home, where something sits between the zone and the whole place.
data_description.vlhkost_dosah:
Humidifying with a window open means humidifying the street. Humidity spreads further than its own room, so you can decide which open windows count.

By default the whole home does; its zone or selected rooms if that is enough for you.
data_description.noc_posun:
How far the target temperature shifts at night. A negative number means heat less, a positive one more, zero leaves the target alone.

The drop begins before night starts so it is not a step; the sleep switch applies at once, whatever the hour.

stineni.title: Blind positions
stineni.description:
For each blind you set which of its saved positions plays which role, and how it should behave. Only the positions that particular blind has are offered.

**shading** — the sun is out and it is hot
**unshading** — it is cold and the sun is welcome inside
**privacy** — after dark, so nobody can see in
**empty home** — when nobody is home
**default position** — where it should return

The options starting with “when” can be set per blind; “same as the room” means the setting from the previous step applies. Whatever you leave empty will not move in that situation.

chovani.title: Room behaviour
chovani.description: How the room should behave. Everything has a sensible default, so you can click through it while setting up and tune it later.

data_description.spanek: A switch you use to say that someone is sleeping in the room.

data_description.dobeh_min: How long after the last motion the room still counts as occupied.

error.zavrit_nad_otevrit: The closing threshold must be lower than the opening one, otherwise the window opens and closes straight away.
error.noc_pod_dnem: The night threshold should not be lower than the daytime one — at night ventilation should start later, not sooner.
error.krize_pod_noci: The emergency level must be above the night one, otherwise it has nothing to override.

user.title: Zone of connected rooms
user.description:
A zone is rooms that breathe together — an open door, a walk-through space. Their air mixes, so the worst value in the zone counts and any window may do the ventilating.

Windows, blinds and thresholds belong to rooms. The zone itself controls nothing, it only says what goes together.

A room that adjoins nothing needs no zone — it decides for itself.

Example: the kitchen and the living room are walk-through, so they form a zone. The bedroom behind a door stands alone, but you set the two zones as neighbours so they can stand in for each other at night.

data_description.nazev: What the zone is called, for example Living room and kitchen.
data_description.mistnosti: Rooms that breathe together. Each may belong to one zone only.
data_description.sousedi: Zones behind a door. When someone sleeps in this zone, a neighbour does the ventilating so nothing blows on your head. It applies at night only.
data_description.dvere: Door sensors between zones; there can be several. Standing in for each other is used only when all of them are open. Without a sensor open is assumed.

user.title: Shared air conditioning
user.description:
A unit serving several rooms, which has to decide whom to please.

The target is computed on the scale of the room the unit stands in, then pushed further by how far the others are above their targets — by two degrees at most, so the room with the unit does not freeze.

An open window does not switch the unit off when it is warmer outside than the target. The window is then open for air and pulls heat in, so cooling is needed exactly now.

data_description.klima_entita: A unit serving several rooms. Do not put a single-room indoor unit here — set that one up with its room and it runs on its own.
data_description.klima_umi: A unit that can heat is used instead of radiators outside the heating season. During the season it will not heat, so the two do not get in each other's way.
data_description.klima_v_pokoji: Where the unit physically stands. It mainly measures this room, so the target is computed on its scale — the cold is pushed into the others by two degrees at most.
data_description.klima_pokoje: Rooms that count towards the decision. Leave out a workshop or a pantry, otherwise they would drag the target.
data_description.chladit_od: How many degrees above the target the room has to be before cooling starts. One degree means: target 24, cool from 25.
data_description.topit_od: How many degrees below the target before heating starts. One degree means: target 22, heat from 21.
data_description.utlum_chlazeni: During a long absence nothing is switched off completely, this temperature is simply held. Bringing the home back up costs more than keeping it there.
data_description.utlum_topeni: The same during the heating season.
data_description.susit_od: Air conditioning can dehumidify. Zero means do not dry — it costs energy for comfort you may not need.
data_description.dlouha_nepritomnost: A switch you use to say that you are away on holiday.
data_description.dlouha_nepritomnost_h: If you have no switch, the setback starts on its own after the home has been empty for this long.
